9	## Intent and authority (explicit)
10	Source: README.md (repository root). Preference IDs with surrounding whitespace must be
11	accepted; trim the ID before lookup; preserve the resilient-read contract: up to three
12	attempts on TransientRead, returning the first success; exhausted transient errors propagate;
13	MissingPreference is permanent and propagates on the first attempt; reads have no side effects.
14	Public entry point: Preferences.read. Repository.read_resilient owns the bounded retry policy;
15	read_once performs one attempt.
16	
17	## Change boundary
18	reader.py: read_preferences now passes key.strip() to repository.read_resilient.
19	tests/test_reads.py: replaced test_existing_key with trim/transient/retry-limit/permanent tests.
20	Unchanged: preferences.py (entry point), repository.py (retry policy, ScriptedBackend).
21	No docs/feat/wip feature directory exists.

25	both changed files are fully contained in the diff hunks (reader.py 2 lines; test file 11 lines).
